d:
Dance into the rain with the timeless melody “Barso Re” from Guru. Composed by A.R. Rahman and sung by Shreya Ghoshal with Uday Mazumdar, this track captures freedom, joy, and celebration perfectly. Featuring the stunning Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, the song remains one of Bollywood’s most iconic rain anthems with lyrics penned by Gulzar.
Credits:
Song Name - Barso Re
Movie - Guru
Singer - Shreya Ghoshal
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricists - Gulzar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
